'''Andrew Meewis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Pleasanton tournament (first event)]] on 16 December 2000 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|MKOS Abyssins]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit (straight, Han for the 10 retrieval)]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1554">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-pleasanton-ca-12-16-00d1554/ pleasanton-ca-12-16-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 17 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-17-pleasanton-ca-12-16-00d1554/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
